title: Test: a declared test command containing a single quote, run by Codex inside its pwsh wrapper — pin whether the declared-route wrapper reader recognises it
outcome: Test: a declared test command containing a single quote, run by Codex inside its pwsh wrapper — pin whether the declared-route wrapper reader recognises it
acceptance: A unit test in src/engram_declared_tests.rs (wrapper reader around :396-450) feeds a declared command line that contains a single quote, wrapped the way Codex reports commands (pwsh envelope), and asserts the actual behaviour: recognised as the declared entry, or refused with a named reason.

If it is refused, docs/features/declared-test-commands.md states the rule (no single quote inside a declared line when Codex runs it) next to its examples; if it is recognised, the onboarding guide's caution is relaxed accordingly.
